quote.author: TheCaptainEli
quote.name: Captain Eli
quote.text:
Notice how the headlines work.

A Toyota crashes: "Driver injured in crash."
A Ford crashes: "Two cars collide on highway."
A BMW crashes: "Accident on Route 1."

A Tesla crashes: "TESLA crashes."

Not the driver. Not "a car." The brand, in the headline, every single time.

Millions of crashes happen on the roads every year, and almost none come with a brand name. But when it's a Tesla, legacy media suddenly cares which car it was.

Meanwhile, Tesla publishes its own safety data every quarter. With Autopilot engaged, Teslas go far more miles between crashes than the US average.

That's not journalism. That's a campaign.

The cars keep getting safer. The headlines just keep getting louder.

quote.author: sundarpichai
quote.name: Sundar Pichai
quote.text:
I did say we'd be releasing our models periodically...introducing Gemini 4 Carbon, our next frontier model.

Following Argon's release just two weeks ago, Carbon shows the pace at which we’re pushing the frontier, it ranks #1 on the recently updated v5.0 of @ArtificialAnlys Intelligence Index at 59. It also leads across key cybersecurity evaluations scoring 88.2% on SEC-bench Pro for finding vulnerabilities, 54.8% on ExploitGym for exploitation, and 71.0% on CWE-bench for patching.

We’re seeing significant improvements in long-horizon tasks even compared to Argon, and we’ve strengthened frontier safeguards.

As we did with Argon, we’re going to roll it out gradually + responsibly. Some trusted cyber defenders will get access starting this week. We'll be expanding it to more partners through our Fairwind Program, ahead of wider availability soon, so hang tight!

posts.text:
FARM ATTACK: Another South African farmer attacked and brutally tortured on his farm this week.

Cattle farmer, Donovan Marx, from the North West province, had his ears cut off on Wednesday morning during a farm attack.
He was also shot in the shoulder and stabbed (with a sharp object) in the leg.

And, for the umpteenth time, as far as I can determine, not a single article on any English media platform about it. This gross coverage disparity between the Afrikaans and English media when it comes to farm murders is what makes it possible for so many politicians and commentators to get away with their disgusting farm murder denialism.

You know what's even more infuriating? History and research shows, if the victim was black and the torturers were white, we would see this story on every front page and news channel for weeks. Debates, panel discussions, political party statements - the works! The president would even come out and condemn the attack.

Again, I refuse to accept the twisted, psychopathic standard that dismisses a farmer having his ears cut off as "just normal crime."

posts.text:
Legacy media will never run this list, so I will.

2018, Flint, Michigan: Elon funded filtration systems for schools with unsafe water. Over $480K.

2018, Thailand: SpaceX engineers built a mini-submarine within days to help rescue a boys' soccer team trapped in a flooded cave.

2020, COVID: He sourced and delivered ventilators and supplies to hospitals for free.

2021: He gave Tesla shares worth about $5.7 billion to charity.

2021: He funded a $100M XPRIZE for carbon removal, one of the largest incentive prizes ever.

2022: Starlink kept Ukrainians connected when their networks went down.

2022, Tonga: Starlink helped reconnect the island after a volcano cut its undersea cable.

Wildfires, hurricanes, earthquakes: Starlink terminals keep showing up for rescuers and families.

And the biggest one, the one that's easy to miss: he's spent his fortune and 20+ years building clean energy, safer cars, and a future for humanity among the stars.

They call him a villain. The record says otherwise.
